Source snapshot:
vendor/botvision/source/CS2-Bot-Vision-v0.1.1-alpha/

Runtime assets:
addons/BotVision/
addons/metamod/BotVision.vdf

The upstream source snapshot is kept unchanged. In upstream configs, the Metamod
VDF is named BotHider.vdf. This project adapts the runtime VDF to
addons/metamod/BotVision.vdf with alias "BotVision" so it does not conflict with
the existing BotHider plugin shipped by this package.
